teacherGuide.conceptGu: Speed round = fluency. Bigger numbers 10-20. Brain train karo!
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Speed builds fluency with numbers up to 20.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Hurtigspil bygger flydende talforståelse op til 20.
teacherGuide.storyDa: Yuvals robot skal bruge 9 batterier. En ven giver ham 8 mere — kan du regne det hurtigere end en computer?
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 First time slow is fine! Personal best matters.
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Første gang er det OK at gå langsomt! Fejr forbedring, ikke perfektion.

questions.textEn: 10 questions — as fast as you can! Timer: 60 seconds
questions.textDa: 10 spørgsmål — så hurtigt du kan! Tid: 60 sekunder
questions.hintGu: Fingers use OK! ઝડપ later આવશે.
questions.hintEn: Use fingers if needed — speed comes with practice!
questions.hintDa: Brug fingrene om nødvendigt — hastighed kommer med øvelse!

questions.textGu: 🤖 Robot ના 9 gears. 8 more found. Total gears?
questions.textEn: Robot had 9 gears. Found 8 more. Total gears?
questions.textDa: Robotten havde 9 tandhjul. Fandt 8 mere. Hvor mange i alt?
